# A03 contract requests

None of these block anything: A03 works today against local supersets and stores
the extra data in `settings`. They would make the shared contracts say what the
data already carries.

## 1. `GithubSummarySchema` (server/contracts/profile.ts): three optional fields

`syncGithub()` stores, and `loadMasterProfile().github` returns at runtime, a
superset of the contract shape (`GithubSummaryFull` in `server/profile/github.ts`):

```ts
export const GithubSummarySchema = z.object({
  login: z.string(),
  syncedAt: z.string(),
  profileUrl: z.string().optional(),            // new: https://github.com/<login>
  repos: z.array(
    z.object({
      name: z.string(),
      url: z.string(),
      description: z.string(),
      languages: z.array(z.string()),
      topics: z.array(z.string()),
      stars: z.number(),
      fork: z.boolean(),
      pushedAt: z.string().nullable(),
      recentCommits: z.number().nullable().optional(), // new: own commits in the last 90 days (capped at 100)
      archived: z.boolean().optional(),                // new
    }),
  ),
});
```

Why: the brief asks for "recent commit activity", and A04 can use it ("actively
maintained") only if the type says it exists. Zod currently strips these fields
when the master profile is re-parsed (for example by `MasterProfileSchema.parse`
in a route), so consumers that parse lose them.

## 2. `unknown_questions`: `answered_at` and `answer_id` columns (server/db.ts)

```sql
ALTER TABLE unknown_questions ADD COLUMN answered_at TEXT;
ALTER TABLE unknown_questions ADD COLUMN answer_id TEXT;   -- answer_bank.id that closed it
```

Why: the digest (A08) and the Questions screen (A10) would like to show "answered
2 days ago, re-queued 3 jobs". Today `answerUnknown()` returns that information
but nothing persists it. Optional; A03 will fill the columns as soon as they exist.

## 3. (Optional) `profile_facts`: index

```sql
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS profile_facts_source ON profile_facts(source, active);
```

Reconcile and listing filter by source; with a few hundred facts it does not
matter yet.
